Secondary airports will overtake growth of main cargo hubs

Secondary cargo airports will grow faster than the current main air cargo hubs in Europe according to an on-line polling organised at the Jan de Rijk Logistics’ summer cocktail event at Schiphol on June 7, where certain market trends were analysed.

A diverse group of forwarders, airlines, GSAs, handling agents and other interest groups at Schiphol airport participated the poll. More than 80 per cent said that apparently infrastructural limitations will hinder growth at the main cargo hubs in Europe, which will benefit secondary airports. Almost 70 per cent of the participants believe that the growth of airports with less catchment area is leading to a faster growth of air cargo trucking volumes compared to the growth of cargo flown by air.

On the other hand, everyone was optimistic about the future of Schiphol, despite the slot restrictions. Around 60 per cent think that the competitive position of Schiphol airport will improve in the next three years due to a better cooperation of the community based on smarter technology.

Nevertheless almost 60 per cent of the companies that were present is not ready yet to go 100 per cent paperless. So, there are still challenges ahead to further improve the air cargo supply chain at Schiphol, although the outlook remains positive.

Finally, people were asked what they value most in selecting their road feeding service provider. Good performance was mentioned as most important element, followed by large network, and quality of customer service. The price and the extend of digitisation were the least important criteria in this selection.

Jan de Rijk Logistics is organizing similar yearly events at large airports in Europe to facilitate networking between different sectors and to obtain valuable industry insights.

Summer News: Smeg & Aerospace
Roosendaal 26-07-2024
– At Jan de Rijk Logistics, we’re pleased to share some exciting news from our team in Italy and our Aerospace unit. These updates reflect our ongoing growth, innovation, and commitment to providing excellent service.

Italy:
Our team in Italy recently wrapped up a special project for one of our valued clients, SMEG. On Tuesday, June 25th, we had the pleasure of hosting the management team from SMEG Netherlands to officially launch their specially branded trailer. Isn’t it a beauty? This unique touch not only strengthens our partnership but also shows our ability to offer personalized services.

Since last year, SMEG has been a customer of Jan de Rijk Logistics International Transport. They are growing rapidly in Europe, with a revenue of about 1 billion euros last year. We primarily serve SMEG from Italy to the Netherlands, France, and Belgium, both intermodally and by road. By integrating the client’s brand into our fleet, we enhance their visibility and foster a sense of collaboration.

We congratulate our team in Italy on their great performance over the past year.

Aerospace:
Our Aerospace unit has recently expanded its operations with two new Mercedes trucks. These modern vehicles are designed to handle the tough demands of transporting sensitive aerospace components. The new trucks not only increase our fleet’s capacity but also improve the reliability and efficiency of our services. This investment shows our dedication to maintaining high standards in logistics and supporting the precise needs of the aerospace industry.

We hope for many happy and safe kilometers!

These updates from our operations in Italy and our Aerospace unit demonstrate Jan de Rijk Logistics’ commitment to excellence and innovation. We’re proud of the progress we’ve made and are excited about what’s ahead. Our focus remains on delivering superior logistics solutions and building strong, lasting partnerships with our clients.

As we continue to grow and innovate, we invite you to stay tuned for more updates from Jan de Rijk Logistics.

For more information about our services or to discuss your logistics needs, contact us directly.

Sustainable Collaboration for a Greener Future!
Roosendaal, March 11,
2025:
At Jan de Rijk Logistics and
Bonduelle
, sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. We believe that by working together in a responsible way, we can create a brighter and greener future. Our focus on sustainability guides our strategies, shapes our decisions, and influences how we manage our supply chains every day.

Our partnership with Bonduelle is built on a shared commitment to environmental care. Every step we take, from planning and organizing logistics to delivering products, is planned with sustainability in mind. This means that we always look for ways to reduce waste, lower our carbon footprint, and support eco-friendly practices. Working together, we make sure that our operations not only meet today’s needs but also protect the environment for the future.

We are very proud to share that our successful collaboration is one of the highlights in the special edition of Business Enquirer. The article in Business Enquirer offers a closer look at how our two companies join forces to build a stronger and more sustainable supply chain. It explains how our combined efforts create a more resilient and environmentally responsible business model. To learn more about this inspiring journey and the many benefits of our partnership, please follow this link to read the full article:
Business Enquirer Issue 135
.

The article is a great example of how sustainability and smart collaboration can work hand in hand. It describes our shared vision of a future where business success and environmental care go together. Our work not only benefits our companies but also supports a better community and a healthier planet.

At Jan de Rijk Logistics and Bonduelle, we are excited about what lies ahead. We continue to explore new ways to improve our practices, reduce our impact on the environment, and set an example in the industry. We are convinced that by combining our strengths and working together, we can overcome challenges and create new opportunities for growth.

We can’t wait to keep building our collaboration and achieving even more together.

The future of

Jan de Rijk Logistics attends the TAPA EMEA conference in Dublin on 23 & 24 October 2019.

Supply chains need to adapt and respond to unprecedented levels of disruption. The need for end-to-end supply chain security and resilience has never been greater.

The Transported Asset Protection Association (TAPA) is a unique forum that unites global manufacturers, logistics providers, freight carriers, law enforcement agencies, and other stakeholders with the common aim of reducing losses from international supply chains.

Jan de Rijk Logistics has been an active TAPA member for over 15 years. Jan de Rijk Logistics offers
secured TAPA transport
that ensures a seamless supply chain integration that gets your product to the customer in a safe and quick way and at the same time keeps your inventory cost low.

Meet our professionals:

Attending the conference will be

and

.

Transport to Austria by road

With Jan de Rijk Logistics’ accumulated experiences, it had thrived throughout the years to be the specialized logistical solution provider in Austria. Our trucks will gladly transport your desired goods to and from Austria, daily, as per your needs, to the locations you require, and the timings you decide! We can also provide you with an economic transport alternative with our intermodal train connection to Austria. Feel free to contact for more information!

By road and rail: intermodal transport to and from Austria

Jan de Rijk Logistics is your specialist for intermodal transport for Austria.

Why use intermodal transportation? Transporting large volumes whether these are FTL or LTL is our core business. We transport in a sustainable and ecological way as we believe this is the best solution for our customers and the environment.

Intermodal transport
is an environmental friendly and economic alternative to transport by road. We arrange door-to-door transport in line with your desired turnaround time for FTL and LTL transport!

Security.
Intermodal transport is very secure. Using dedicated intermodal cargo units protects the freight during the transport cycle, reducing the risk of theft and damage to a minimum. Our service is from door-to-door, from pickup to delivery. Strict procedures ensure a safe transition between first and final mile movements and the train. On the train, the shipment is in a sealed closed container on a direct rail connection to the destination. We make sure your container is continuously on the move.

Environmental benefits.
Sustainability is important for us – and for our customers. We are focused on sustainability and we are developing solutions to limit our impact on the environment. Compared to road transport intermodal transport results in a reduction of your carbon footprint. Intermodal connections can result in up to 80% lower CO2 emissions compared to road

Feel free to contact us and discover what we can do for you!

Hörsching is located near the capital of the federal state of Upper-Austria: Linz. We’ll keep you at complete ease by arranging you with the transport service best suitable for your needs.

It is not without reason that our customers have entrusted us with their most vulnerable and urgent products for years. You owe the reliability to our highly motivated and well-trained employees. Groupage or LTL services

Does the transport of your goods not need to be delivered in a hurry? One of our specialties is groupage of partial shipments. Do you need to ship some goods urgently? Then choose our shipping service! In addition to that, we offer FTL transport, multimodal or LTL transport to Austria with a longer transit time and lower costs.

Intermodal transport to Austria

In addition to Jan de Rijk Logistics’ own train connection with Italy, we also offer intermodal transport to and from Austria. The train runs between Neuss in the Benelux and Wels in Austria. From there, we ensure that your goods are delivered to the right place through road transport. Still unsure about which logistical solutions will best fit your Austria transport requirements? We’re more than happy to walk you through the options we have!

By road and rail: intermodal transport to and from Italy

We operate our own trains, which depart twice daily between Milan and Venlo. Jan de Rijk Logistics is your specialist for transport to Italy, by road transport and intermodal transport.

Why use intermodal transportation? Transporting large volumes whether these are FTL or LTL is our core business. We do this in a sustainable and ecological way as we believe this is the best solution for our customers and the environment.

Intermodal transport
is an environmental friendly and economic alternative to transport by road. We arrange door-to-door transport in line with your desired turnaround time for FTL and LTL transport!

Security.
Intermodal transport is very secure. Using dedicated intermodal cargo units protects the freight during the transport cycle, reducing the risk of theft and damage to a minimum. Our service is from door-to-door, from pickup to delivery. Strict procedures ensure a safe transition between first and final mile movements and the train. On the train the shipment is in a sealed closed container on a direct rail connection to the destination. We make sure your container is continuously on the move.

Environmental benefits.
Sustainability is important for us – and for our customers. We are focused on sustainability and we are developing solutions to limit our impact on the environment. Compared to road transport intermodal transport results in a reduction of your carbon footprint. Intermodal connections can result in up to 80% lower CO2 emissions compared to road

By road and rail: intermodal transport to and from Poland

Jan de Rijk Logistics is your specialist for intermodal transport on Poland.

Why use intermodal transportation? Transporting large volumes whether these are FTL or LTL is our core business. We do this in a sustainable and ecological way as we believe this is the best solution for our customers and the environment.

Intermodal transport
is an environmental friendly and economic alternative to transport by road. We arrange door-to-door transport in line with your desired turnaround time for FTL and LTL transport!

Security.
Intermodal transport is very secure. Using dedicated intermodal cargo units protects the freight during the transport cycle, reducing the risk of theft and damage to a minimum. Our service is from door-to-door, from pickup to delivery. Strict procedures ensure a safe transition between first and final mile movements and the train. On the train, the shipment is in a sealed closed container on a direct rail connection to the destination. We make sure your container is continuously on the move.

Environmental benefits.
Sustainability is important for us – and for our customers. We are focused on sustainability and we are developing solutions to limit our impact on the environment. Compared to road transport intermodal transport results in a reduction of your carbon footprint. Intermodal connections can result in up to 80% lower CO2 emissions compared to road

Hola Spain

Transport to and from Spain by road

Every day, we start our mornings with one mission, which is delivering satisfaction in the form of a quality transport service. Our trucks will gladly transport your desired goods to and from various Spanish cities, daily, as per your needs, to the locations you require, and the timings you decide!

Still wondering about what solutions we can offer?
Contact

By road and rail: intermodal transport to and from Spain

Jan de Rijk Logistics is your specialist for intermodal transport for Spain.

Why use intermodal transportation? Transporting large volumes whether these are FTL or LTL is our core business. We transport in a sustainable and ecological way as we believe this is the best solution for our customers and the environment.

Intermodal transport
is an environmental friendly and economic alternative to transport by road. We arrange door-to-door transport in line with your desired turnaround time for FTL and LTL transport!

Security.
Intermodal transport is very secure. Using dedicated intermodal cargo units protects the freight during the transport cycle, reducing the risk of theft and damage to a minimum. Our service is from door-to-door, from pickup to delivery. Strict procedures ensure a safe transition between first and final mile movements and the train. On the train, the shipment is in a sealed closed container on a direct rail connection to the destination. We make sure your container is continuously on the move.

Environmental benefits.
Sustainability is important for us – and for our customers. We are focused on sustainability and we are developing solutions to limit our impact on the environment. Compared to road transport intermodal transport results in a reduction of your carbon footprint. Intermodal connections can result in up to 80% lower CO2 emissions compared to road

Feel free to contact us and discover what we can do for you!

Why Jan de Rijk Logistics is the right partner for transport to Spain of your goods?

You’ll always be in safe hands if you choose
Jan de Rijk Logistics
! Our experts in Spain have been in the Spanish market for years. Hence, they’re fully familiar with the Spanish culture, language, legal system, and geography. Also, our office being at the international airport of Barcelona gives us a geographical advantage! We’ll keep you at complete ease by arranging you with the transport service best suitable for your needs.

Request a quote

Advanced and dynamic order management and planning system

For you as a customer, you’ll have maximum visibility and transparency. You can track the vehicles and loads with real-time tracking & tracing system. Jan de Rijk Logistics works with an advanced and dynamic order management and planning system to ensure you a great quality service and goods safely delivered.

LTL or groupage transport to Spain

Does the transport of your goods not need to be delivered in a hurry? Groupage of partial shipments is one of our specialties. Do you need to ship some goods urgently? Then choose our shipping service! In addition to that, we offer FTL transport, multimodal or LTL transport to Spain with a longer transit time and lower costs. Jan de Rijk Logistics can provide you with various logistical solutions.

Daily Destinations in Spain

Due to our familiarity with the different routes and destinations in Spain. We will provide you with the most efficient route to the final destination of your products depending on the nature of the goods. We have daily departures to and from the area of Barcelona and Madrid, and that was made possible due to the double-manned transport. We’re available 24/7 and we promise you efficiency, speed, flexibility, and safety. Do you have a different destination in mind? We’ll be more than happy to assist you and provide you with the best suitable offer. Jan de Rijk Logistics ensures reliable and safe transport throughout Europe.

Brexit

Information about transport to the United Kingdom

21 December Update

France blocked arrivals of UK passengers for 48 hours over concerns about the new coronavirus variant.

Freight lorries cannot cross by sea or through the Eurotunnel and the Port of Dover has closed to outbound traffic.About 10,000 lorries a day travel between Dover and Calais during peak periods such as Christmas.UK ministers will discuss the move at a Cobra emergency committee on Monday.On Sunday, Transport Secretary Grant Shapps urged the public and hauliers not to travel to ports in Kent, saying “significant disruption” was likely in the area.Kent Police have mobilised Operation Stack – a system to park lorries on the M20 motorway in Kent at times of disruption – to deal with the build-up of traffic.

Swiftly proceed through the Dutch ports after Brexit

Transport

to Turkey

Gateway to Turkey

Transport to Turkey by road

Jan de Rijk Logistics takes care of the transport of your goods to Turkey. With years of experience, we are your specialist for transport to Turkey. We also arrange transport from Turkey. Jan de Rijk Logistics offers you various transport options for transporting your goods to and from Turkey. We provide a suitable offer! Feel free to
contact us
or request a
quote
.

By road and rail: intermodal transport to and from Turkey

Jan de Rijk Logistics is your specialist for intermodal transport on Turkey.

Why use intermodal transportation? Transporting large volumes whether these are FTL or LTL is our core business. We do this in a sustainable and ecological way as we believe this is the best solution for our customers and the environment.

Intermodal transport
is an environmental friendly and economic alternative to transport by road. We arrange door-to-door transport in line with your desired turnaround time for FTL and LTL transport!

Security.
Intermodal transport is very secure. Using dedicated intermodal cargo units protects the freight during the transport cycle, reducing the risk of theft and damage to a minimum. Our service is from door-to-door, from pickup to delivery. Strict procedures ensure a safe transition between first and final mile movements and the train. On the train, the shipment is in a sealed closed container on a direct rail connection to the destination. We make sure your container is continuously on the move.

Environmental benefits.
Sustainability is important for us – and for our customers. We are focused on sustainability and we are developing solutions to limit our impact on the environment. Compared to road transport intermodal transport results in a reduction of your carbon footprint. Intermodal connections can result in up to 80% lower CO
2
emissions compared to road

Feel free to contact us and discover what we can do for you!

Mega Trailers &

Combi trucks
Flexible

transport

Why Jan de Rijk Logistics for transport to Turkey?

Jan de Rijk Logistics
knows better than anyone how important it is that your goods arrive in Turkey at the right time and safely. Our Turkey experts have been working in this market for years. Thanks to our own capacity, we are very flexible. In addition, our central planning department is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

Request a quote

Select your destination and receive a quote immediately.

Reliable transport of your goods to and from Turkey

Jan de Rijk Logistics ensures reliable and safe transport to and from Turkey and is also known all over Europe. Depending on the nature and destination of the goods or circumstances, we provide the most suitable route for the transport of your goods. Do you for example want a fast and continuous service? Then ask about the possibilities for double-manned transport. It is not without reason that our customers entrust us year after year with their most urgent and vulnerable products for transport. Are you aware of the progress of your transport? Digitization and transparency are of great importance in the transport world. At Jan de Rijk Logistics you benefit from seamless communication, tracking & tracing, and professional support from our employees.

IT Systems

IT solutions are crucial for our logistics solutions. By using advanced systems, such as transport management, planning and tracking & tracing software, we ensure optimal control of our distribution and service for you. This includes digital consignment notes and real-time shipment information that we make available in our customer portal.

Groupage or LTL transport to Turkey

In addition to FTL transport, Jan de Rijk Logistics offers even more options for your goods. Consider, for example, groupage of partial shipments, multimodal or LTL transport. We provide a logistics solution that suits your needs.

Business Controller – Roosendaal

32 – 40 uur per week

Waar ga je werken?

Jan de Rijk Logistics (opgericht in 1971) is een toonaangevende Europese logistieke dienstverlener, opererend met een moderne vloot van 1.000 voertuigen en diverse gespecialiseerde warehouses. Het bedrijf levert een breed scala aan diensten, waaronder intermodale oplossingen, internationaal transport, contract logistics, Benelux en retail distributie, containertransport, temperatuur gecontroleerd transport, evenementen logistiek en forwarding.

Met 24 kantoren in 13 landen en meer dan 1300 medewerkers in Europa biedt dit familiebedrijf niet alleen uitdagende en gevarieerde taken aan, maar ook moderne werkplekken in een vertrouwde omgeving met gemotiveerde teams.

Krijg je energie van de continue dynamiek in de logistiek? Ben jij nieuwsgierig, gedreven en een echte aanpakker? Dan zit je bij Jan de Rijk Logistics op de juiste plek. Je krijgt de kans om je persoonlijk te ontwikkelen en samen met een gevarieerde groep collega’s verder te groeien. Samen regelen we het!
THAT’S HOW.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Business Controller ben je de financiële sparringpartner voor de managementteams van de verschillende business units binnen Jan de Rijk Logistics. Je analyseert kritisch de financiële prestaties, signaleert afwijkingen en adviseert over verbetermogelijkheden. Daarnaast ben je nauw betrokken bij het opstellen van financiële rapportages, begrotingen en forecasts om inzicht te geven in de financiële gezondheid van de onderneming. .

Kerntaken en verantwoordelijkheden:

Monitoren, analyseren en rapporteren van financiële resultaten per business unit

Uitvoeren van analyses op kosten, marges, cashflows en overige financiële KPI’s

Onderzoeken van afwijkingen en formuleren van adviezen ter verbetering

Voorbereiden van managementrapportages en dashboards

Bijdragen aan begrotingsprocessen en financiële planning & control cycli

Adviseren over financiële vraagstukken aan lijn- en projectmanagers

Identificeren van financiële risico’s en beheersmaatregelen voorstellen

Ondersteunen bij strategische besluitvorming met financiële analyses

Wie ben jij?

Je hebt HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur richting Bedrijfseconomie of Accountancy

Je hebt 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring

Uitstekende analytische en adviesvaardigheden

Cijfermatig sterk met een kritische en onderzoekende instelling

Kennis van financiële rekensystemen, forecasting en managementrapportages

Goede communicatieve en overtuigingskracht op alle niveaus

Stressbestendig en in staat om prioriteiten te stellen

Flexibele en hands-on werkhouding met een proactieve instelling

Ervaring met Qlik en Oracle zijn een pré

Kerncompetenties: Stressbestendig, initiatiefrijk, zelfstandig, integer, proactief, representatief.

Wat bieden wij?

Een salaris in overleg;

24 tot 28 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. je leeftijd)

3,5 ATV dagen

Reiskostenvergoeding woon-werkverkeer vanaf 10 km en tot 35 km enkele reis

Flexibele werktijden

Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken (maximaal 1 dag per week)

Laptop & mobiele telefoon

Enthousiaste collega’s in je werkomgeving;

Korte communicatielijnen en een platte organisatiestructuur;

Interesse?

Ben jij na het lezen van deze vacature helemaal enthousiast geworden? Stuur dan jouw CV naar:
werken@janderijk.com

Business Analyst

About us

Jan de Rijk Logistics has become the leading logistics provider in the field of transportation, distribution as well as contract logistics and offers innovative and unique solutions in the European market. To achieve lean logistics on a fast changing market, we invest in quality, development and education of our employees, equipped with excellent tools for data analysis, Machine learning and AI, so innovative and unique solutions are offered for our customers.

Does this raise your interest?

Then we have a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to join our business unit International Transport. We are looking for a fulltime Business Analyst who wants to work in a self-steering team. Taking ownership of the tasks to be performed and take on an active role in making the best discissions for our operational processes to fulfill customers needs optimally.

Your job

As a Business Analyst, you are responsible for understanding and assessing the changing needs of the business unit International Transport. Your main goal is to initiate new ideas and have an impact on the required developments. We expect that you will be making a constructive contribution to the unique and challenging tasks on a daily basis.

To achieve this goal, it requires strong communication skills from you. Especially to make processes and their underlying structure of data accessible to relevant stakeholders. You also need the ability to adapt and be open-minded to learn, become active and face new challenges not only within, but also beyond of the fields of International Transport.

The following key words are important in your new job:

Optimization:
You will identify problems and opportunities, so changes will be applied for greater efficiencies.

Modelling:
You will translate economics and business questions into econometric models.

Analysis Projects:
You will be executing various analysis projects in a team or independently, this includes the definition, executions and presentation of results.

Visualization:
You will be visualizing solutions and data with Business Intelligence Tools or software’s e.g. Qlik.

A key part in your job is to gather the required information by asking the right questions to the right people. You will be responsible for an objective point of view, in order to take a critical look at existing and new processes. So insights will be derived to reveal associations and correlations in order to strive for excellent results.

You will be working with a dynamic team of professionals within the Business Unit International Transport, and also with employees from other business units or departments within Jan de Rijk Logistics. In this role you will report to the Director of International Transport.

Qualities

The described values of analytical skills, problem-solving oriented and self-driven independence, as well as the extraordinary challenges associated with the position as Business Analyst. Are you the ideal candidate? Then you have the following qualities:

High level education (Bachelor Degree in technical, science, business, or related discipline);

Ideally you already have experience within International Transport, but it is okay if you don’t. We will learn it to you!

You already have experience with analysis or process optimization;

Your capabilities to solve (analytical) problems are excellent;

You prefer a job in a fast-paced environment and you have the ability to handle multiple projects as well as tasks in parallel;

You have the ability to think critically but also out of the box;

You know all tricks from Microsoft Office Excel;

You’re fluent in English and preferably Dutch.

Is this your new dream job?

Send your motivation and resume to:
werken@janderijk.com

Do you have any questions about this job? You can contact our HR department via +31 (0)165 572813

Jan de Rijk Logistics is a logistics service provider active in the field of international transport, warehouse services, Benelux distribution and supply chain solutions. Jan de Rijk Logistics is active in the field of airfreight, automotive, healthcare, retail and high-tech.

Minimum of 2 years experience as customer service / planner / sales and looking for a next step;

You are a responsible, customer-oriented and independently working team player with well-developed communication and commercial skills;

International Freight Forwarder – Roosendaal

Who are we?

Jan de Rijk Logistics is a logistics service provider active in the field of international transport, warehouse services, Benelux distribution and supply chain solutions. Jan de Rijk Logistics is active in the field of airfreight, automotive, healthcare, retail and high-tech.

With 27 offices in 13 countries and more than 1.300 employees in Europe, this family business offers not only challenging and varied tasks, but also modern workplaces in a familiar environment with motivated teams. Despite its size, the lines are short, the doors are always open and there is an informal working atmosphere.

Job description

For our Forwarding Department (part of international planning) at our location in Roosendaal, the Netherlands, we are looking for a proactive and positive person who wants to work as a freight forwarder. You take care of the transport for our customers. With your commitment and experience you will strengthen our department.

Every day you are busy to provide the customer with excellent service and you go about your work problem-solving. You are active with a diversity of shipments throughout Europe.

Other tasks in your role are:

Purchase charters for shipments throughout Europe;

Actively participate in projects within the business unit International Transport;

Ensure that customer agreements are met;

Requesting and negotiating the right rates for proper procurement of transport capacity.

Location

The location for this position is at our main location in Roosendaal.

Who are you?

We are always looking for people who want to make a difference and add value to our organisation. The qualities we value are: commitment, responsibility, collegiality, ownership. We also consider the following points to be important for the position:

Minimum of 1 years’ experience as a forwarding agent / freight forwarder or planner;

Good command of the Dutch and English languages;

An enthusiastic, proactive and positive mentality;

You are a responsible, customer-oriented and independently working team player with well-developed communication and commercial skills;

You have experience with automated systems;

You think in terms of solutions and possibilities;

You are stress resistant, entrepreneurial and eager to learn.

We offer

A job in a dynamic team;

Day shifts from Monday to Friday;

The prospect of permanent employment if you perform well;

A dynamic work environment with colleagues and relations throughout Europe;

Training and development opportunities on both a professional and personal level;

No two days are the same and this ensures a lot of variety in your work;

An excellent remuneration package in line with the market (CAO Beroepsgoederenvervoer).

Functiebeschrijving

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het maken van een optimale transport planning. Onze werkzaamheden bestaan voor 80% uit FTL werkzaamheden en 20% groupage. Je zoekt continue naar de meest efficiënt mogelijke inzet van personeel (± 90 chauffeurs) en materieel (± 60 wagens) door heel de Benelux en volgt, bewaakt en verbetert van toepassing zijnde processen en procedures. Tevens draag jij zorg voor de informatievoorziening richting onze chauffeurs en klanten. Uiteraard doe je dit niet alleen! Je werkt nauw samen met jouw 10 collega’s van de afdeling Benelux.

Het leveren van kwaliteit staat centraal in jouw werk, wij stellen zelfstandigheid en het nemen van initiatieven op prijs.

Je hebt HBO werk- en denkniveau;

Je hebt uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal. Kennis van de Duitse taal is een pré;

Marktconforme arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Management Traineeship

University of applied sciences / University (HBO / WO)

North Brabant / Limburg region

Are you ambitious, do you have a clear vision and would you like to further develop your leadership skills?

In addition, did you graduate at HBO/WO level almost or at most 2 years ago, in a business economics, commercial or logistics direction? Then come and work at Jan de Rijk Logistics and become our new Management Trainee! In two years we will prepare you for a position at management level in the field that suits you best.

What are you going to do?

In 2 years you will fulfill 4 full functions within different business units in our organization. This includes the following functions; Account Manager, Controller, Engineer, Forwarder, Planner, Project Manager or Supervisor.

In addition to fulfilling an operational role, you will also deal with current issues on a project basis, you will participate in development sessions and you will work together with our managers on strategic cases.

By participating in our traineeship, you receive the ideal combination of learning and gaining practical experience. The traineeship is aimed at developing you both personally and professionally. You become aware of your motivations, qualities and pitfalls. During the traineeship you learn to get the best out of yourself. You think along about innovative ways to optimize our services, so that we always stay one step ahead of developments in the market.

Your profile

You have (almost) graduated at HBO/WO level, in a business economics, commercial or logistics direction. You are driven and have a clear vision. You are analytically strong and know how to quickly create an overview. You do not wait but investigate, ask and do. Of course you have good communication skills in the Dutch and English language.

You are decisive, goal-oriented, stress resistant and have the drive to grow into a great position within our company.

Your Skills:

Achieving high performance;

Make customer successful;

Developing others;

Analyzing and solving problems;

Offer

We offer you an extensive traineeship with a lot of attention for your development with a good salary. Of course you will receive a laptop and telephone from the company. During the traineeship you will be intensively supervised by senior managers and board members. After completing the traineeship, we offer you a job at management level within one of our business units.

Interested?

Are you interested in our Traineeship and do you meet the profile? Send your motivation letter and CV to:
werken@janderijk.com

Application procedure

You will receive a substantive response within two weeks of receiving your application. We make a first selection based on all letters and CVs received. If you are selected from this, you will receive an invitation for a (digital) introduction to the IT director and HR Manager. After this, an in-depth discussion will take place with 2 Business Unit Directors.

Operations Manager Central Planning – Roosendaal

Jan de Rijk Logistics is a leading logistics service provider in the field of transport, distribution and contract logistics and offers innovative and unique solution on the European market. To realize lean logistics in a rapidly changing market, we invest in quality, development and training of our employees.

Would you like to know more about International Transport business unit? Click
here

Job description

As Operations Manager Central Planning you are ultimately responsible for the quality and performance of the planning made by your team in Roosendaal, you will work within the International Transport business unit. You ensure the best possible use of the total fleet, which consist of more than 700 assets. You ensure that we provide an excellent service to our customers based on the agreed SLA’s and SOP’s.

In this role you directly manage a team of supervisors, the entire team consists of more than 20 transport planners. You are in daily contact with the Branch Managers of out other offices.

Quality

We attach great importance to the quality of our performance, which is why you are aware of the performance at any time of the day. You pay attention to, among other things, the loading meters, empty kilometers and the margins of certain lanes. Based on predefined KPI’s you assess whether there are deviations, if necessary you determine the necessary actions, set priorities and delegate these tasks t your team.

To increase quality, you analyze the lanes driven, possibly together with a Business Analyst. If necessary, you prepare proposals for improvement, which you present to the General Manager Excellence Logistics. You also make cost price calculations in collaboration with our financial department. You also play a role in drawing up the budget for the International Transport Business Unit.

Performance & Quality

You monitor the performance and quality of the operation on a daily basis, you do this in a specially developed system with associated dashboard (Qlik). You contribute to the (further) development of, among other things, the planning system by actively participating in project within the organization that are aimed at improving performance. You have many interfaces with IT and you enjoy working with digitalization.

Organization development

As a manager you are responsible for developing your team, in which you take an active role. This means, among other things, that you periodically speak to all your employees and focus on their own development, by means of your employee’s Personal Development Plan. You encourage your team to develop to a higher level.

We think it is important to work closely with schools, which is why we often work with interns, you will act as their internship supervisor.

Sparring partner

You are an important sparring partner for, among other things, the Director of International Transport, the Manager Customer Service and the General Manager Excellence Capacity. You have daily contact with the operations of the various branches with planning departments.

You are also an important sparring partner for our sales department in tender projects or in special developments for a specific department within the business unit.

You are P&L responsible, you provide unput to the International Transport Director for the preparation of the annual plan and budget.

It concerns a role on a tactical level. You manager the team of planners in Roosendaal, which consists of more than 20 (junior) planners. You report to the General Manager Excellence Logistics.

100 days

For this role we work with a 100 day plan, during the first period you will become acquainted with our basis processes and you will get to know your team and colleagues from other departments. After this you will further delve into our planning processes and learning from our organization and the associated locations.

Who are you?

You know better than anyone what is going on within Internation Transport and you can translate this well to your direct colleagues and manager due to your good communication skills.

As our Operations Manager Central Planning you meet the following profile:

HBO working and thinking level;

You have demonstrable experience in a similar role within the transport sector;

You have good leadership qualities, which enable you to inspire and motivate your team;

You are someone who constantly strives for improvement, for his you make improvement proposals and implement them within you own team;

We don’t have to tell you anything about digitization, you are even the initiator in this area;

You know how to set priorities and can set the necessary actions for this with your team or external parties;

You have excellent communication skills of the Dutch an English language in word an writing.

We offer

We are happy to offer you the opportunity to develop within a dynamic, successful and growing organization.

Within this role you have a challenging and responsible position where you really make an impact! You will be part of a group of driven, talented and enthusiastic colleagues. We also offer you:

A nice salary, which is paid to you every four weeks;

A dynamic work environment with colleagues and relations throughout Europe;

Training and development opportunities on both a professional and personal level;

No two days are the same and this ensures a lot of variety in your work;

An excellent remuneration package in line with the market (CAO Beroepsgoederenvervoer).

Interested?

Have you become completely enthusiastic after read this vacancy? Then send your resume to:

Warehousemedewerker – Roosendaal

40 uur per week

Jan de Rijk Logistics

Bij Jan de Rijk Logistics, opgericht in 1971, combineren we traditie met innovatie. Met een moderne vloot van ongeveer 1.000 voertuigen en diverse gespecialiseerde warehouses, zijn we een toonaangevende Europese logistieke dienstverlener. Onze dienstverlening is veelzijdig, van intermodale oplossingen tot internationaal transport, contract logistics, Benelux en retail distributie, containertransport, temperatuur gecontroleerd transport, evenementen logistiek en forwarding.

Als familiebedrijf met meer dan 1300 medewerkers verspreid over Europa, bieden we niet alleen een uitdagende, dynamische en moderne werkomgeving, maar ook een plek waar je je thuis voelt in een team van gemotiveerde collega’s.

Ben jij de warehousemedewerker die wij zoeken?

Krijg je energie van de continue dynamiek in de logistiek? Ben jij nieuwsgierig, gedreven en een echte aanpakker? Dan zit je bij Jan de Rijk Logistics op de juiste plek. Je krijgt een allround warehousemedewerker functie, waarbij je veel kennis en ervaring opdoet. Dit is jouw kans om te groeien en een verschil te maken binnen een vooruitstrevend team met afwisselende taken.

Samen regelen we het!
THAT’S HOW.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Warehousemedewerker ben je verantwoordelijk voor het laden en lossen, orderpicken, man up en het controleren van de inkomende en uitgaande vracht.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

Het op pallets laden en lossen met behulp van een EPT;

Het verzamelen van de orders; het picken van de orders gaat aan de hand van dozen stapelen, instructies krijg je vanuit het geautomatiseerde systeem

Pallets op voorraad zetten in de stelling;

Kwaliteitscontrole uitvoeren en het controleren van goederen op aantallen en schades

Het op een correcte manier omgaan met alle goederen en de ter beschikking staande transportmiddelen.

Afhankelijk van de soort werkzaamheden kan het zijn dat je waarbij nodig overuren kan maken.

Wie ben jij?

Jij weet als geen ander wat er speelt binnen onze operatie en gaat met veel motivatie iedere dag weer aan het werk. Je gaat zorgvuldig en resultaatgericht te werk.

Als onze nieuwe Warehousemedewerker voldoe jij aan onderstaand profiel:

Je hebt 1 tot 2 jaar relevante werkervaring in een soortgelijke functie;

Je hebt goede communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel in de Nederlandse- als Engelse taal;

Je bent een aanpakker, bewaakt het overzicht en kan goed prioriteiten stellen;

Je bent in bezit van een Heftruck en EPT-certificaat, een reachtruck certificaat is een pre

Wat bieden wij?

Wij bieden jou graag de kans je te ontwikkelen binnen een dynamische, succesvolle en groeiende organisatie. Binnen deze rol heb je een uitdagende en verantwoordelijke functie waarbij je echt impact maakt! Je gaat deel uitmaken van een groep gedreven, getalenteerde en enthousiaste collega’s. Tevens bieden wij je:

Een arbeidsovereenkomst voor bepaalde tijd (12 maanden) met uitzicht op onbepaalde tijd;

Een mooi salaris, dat iedere vier weken aan jou wordt uitbetaald;

Een moderne werkomgeving met een team dat gedreven is om te innoveren

Aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals 8% vakantietoeslag, goede pensioenopbouw, 27,5 vakantiedagen (inclusief ATV) en teamuitjes.

Interesse in de functie warehousemedewerker?

Ben jij na het lezen van deze vacature enthousiast geworden? Stuur dan jouw CV en motivatie naar

Italy

Logistica Senza Confini

Crossdocking, warehousing and distribution
The logistics facility offers a prime strategic location for efficient distribution throughout Northern Italy. Situated close to major roads and Milan airports, it allows for seamless connectivity to key transportation hubs, minimizing transit times and maximizing efficiency. The facility is also located near the Melzo terminal, which is part of the main GENOVA – LA SPEZIA railway line. This proximity to a major rail link provides excellent options for rail freight, contributing to flexible logistics solutions and smooth integration into larger supply chains.

The building has been constructed with a focus on environmental sustainability. Equipped with energy-efficient systems like heat pumps and solar panels, it aims to lower energy consumption and reduce operating costs. Additionally, the facility includes rainwater recycling systems, which further enhance its eco-friendly profile and support sustainable resource management. This commitment to sustainability not only minimizes the environmental footprint but also supports clients’ green initiatives, making it an ideal choice for companies with a focus on reducing their carbon impact.

Security and accessibility are key strengths of this logistics facility. It is situated in a fenced area with a single controlled entrance, which helps in maintaining a secure perimeter. The facility is monitored round the clock with 24/7 surveillance to ensure a safe working environment and protect both personnel and goods. The combination of controlled access and continuous monitoring means that clients can have peace of mind, knowing that their inventory is being kept in a secure, reliable environment.

Effortless logistics between Italy and the Netherlands

When you’re shipping goods between Italy and the Netherlands, you need reliability, speed, and a team you can trust. That’s exactly what we deliver at Jan de Rijk Logistics. With our daily transport services, we make sure your goods move smoothly, every step of the way.

Imagine your goods travelling seamlessly across borders, passing through our efficient cross-docking centres in Milan and Roosendaal. We know timing is everything, so our Milan warehouse is ready to store and handle your products, ensuring they’re always in the right place at the right time. Whether it’s pallets of fresh produce or general cargo, our specialised team treats each consignment with care and efficiency.

Our transport network is primed to handle the load – securely, quickly, and without a fuss. We focus on dependable solutions that keep your supply chain flowing smoothly, day in and day out.

Ready for a simple, effective logistics solution that takes the load off your mind? Leave your email, and let’s craft a plan that meets your needs. With Jan de Rijk, you’re in good hands.

We spoke to one of our Bulgarian drivers

Roosendaal, 29 April 2020 –
Recently, we spoke to one of our Bulgarian drivers: Todor Yanakiev. He had his weekly rest in Roosendaal. Todor Yanakiev is 45 years old and has been working at Jan de Rijk Logistics since October 2013. We spoke to him briefly and were curious about his experiences at Jan de Rijk Logistics and what he likes the most about his profession. In view of the current situation, we were of course also curious about what he experiences along the way from the Coronavirus.

What does a working day look like?

Todor starts the day with a cup of tea and breakfast. In doing so, he already looks at his tasks for the day so that he knows what awaits him. Depending on his schedule for the day, he starts loading or unloading the goods with his truck. When his working day is over, relaxing begins: reading the news, calling friends and family and sometimes watching TV before going to sleep. He is mainly found on the road in Western and Central Europe. His favorite destinations to drive are Spain (he lived there for about 10 years) and Sweden.

Why driver at Jan de Rijk Logistics?

Almost 7 years ago, Todor chose Jan de Rijk Logistics as an employer. Todor chose Jan de Rijk Logistics because he heard that it is a reliable company that gives you the opportunity to further develop yourself and grow in the job. It is not without reason that Todor has been working at Jan de Rijk Logistics for a long time. Therefore, we were curious what he likes the most about his work. He likes the good and respectful relationship with the people in the office. In addition, the fact that the salary is paid on time and that there is the possibility to take his weekly rest at a Jan de Rijk Logistics home base.

What do you currently notice about the Coronavirus?

Given the current circumstances, we were curious to find out what Todor is experiencing as a result of the Coronavirus. He indicated that due to the current circumstances, there is a lot less traffic on the road, both fewer trucks and passenger cars. In addition, he notices that some people are really upset and panicked by the whole situation. There are also far fewer people on the street and there is an extreme social distance. It is a strange situation!

A nice quote from our driver to conclude

Since about a month, Todor has been driving a brand new truck from Jan de Rijk Logistics as you can see in the pictures! Todor closed the conversation with a beautiful and appropriate quote from Charlie Chaplin: “
A day without a smile and a laughter is a day totally wasted
”.
